calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(pct_change(close),3) when abs(cross_sectional_mean(sign(pct_change(close))) - 0.5) exceeds its lagged 120-day 70th percentile; otherwise 0; cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Fades three-day returns only when the cross-asset breadth is unusually one-sided, using lagged threshold information to avoid look-ahead. The resulting signal is median demeaned across the 15 tradable instruments.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across full history, recent 2024+ window, and the short post-online sample; conservative interpretation warranted because the cross-section has 15 instruments and only 460 gated dates.
